protocol.stage1_training: per-task mean/sd and the PCA basis are fitted on the fit rows (frac <= 0.6) of ALL 20 identities. Fold-invariant, computed once. This is the user-defined training stage; it is deliberately NOT restricted to the enrolled identities.
protocol.stage2_enrolment: prototypes of the 15 enrolled identities only, from their own prototype rows: variant 'fit' = fit rows (frac <= 0.6), variant 'fit_eval' = fit + eval rows (frac <= 0.8, upper-bound reference). k_proto = 12 for e65, 1 for subwin6 and e162.
protocol.stage3_deployment: every evaluation-block row (0.6 < frac <= 0.8) of ALL 20 identities is scored against the 15 enrolled prototypes: argmax over the enrolled identities = identification, best-match score < tau = rejection (label 0).
protocol.threshold_rule: tau = quantile(the 15 enrolled identities' best-match scores in the evaluation window, 1 - a); calibrated on enrolled identities only, the 5 unregistered never enter the threshold
protocol.fold_rule: k = 5: 500 distinct random 5-subsets of the 20 identities drawn from C(20,5) with numpy default_rng(20261116 + 5), i.e. the same generator and seed rule as E197 (E197 drew 200)

test_reference.note: the task's 0.7415 equals E197's k=5 fold-matched Test S1 rejection averaged over its 9 unsupervised gates (results.json analysis.test_s1_match['5'].test_mean). It is a cross-batch reading and is quoted, not re-computed here
